comparison_population: All72 orders in same single selected exposure; descriptive controls, not independent validation.
limitations: One exposure selected in the fixed remaining M queue; summary is not an independent calibration.
Rank, winsorized and subwindow metrics are not acceptance gates and do not justify relaxing the original Pearson gate.
Spatial-offset curves probe fixed apertures; their maxima do not refit mapping or select new coordinates.
All pre-existing edge and reference limitations are retained. No statistic reconstructs missing detector pixels.
No cosmic-ray mask, raw background model or pipeline-equivalent extraction is inferred from correlation changes.
